name: Ismene Circe
source:
Ismene is a smart yet reserved girl who's often stuck in her own head or stuck in books. She loves mystery and is always looking for a good story... fictional or not. She tends to be rather morbid and makes inappropriate jokes about death, but she does have some self control.

She often doesn't hold relationships or friendships as dear as the other person in the friendship- which can lead to arguments and whatever bonds she manages to establish quickly break down. Behind it all, Ismene has a Goddess complex. She believes she's smarter than everyone else and should be treated better than the majority.

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CYPajkmNkM2/]official description[/url]]
